SELECT 
    SUBSTRING(r_reason_desc FROM 1 FOR 20),
    AVG(ws_quantity),
    AVG(wr_refunded_cash),
    AVG(wr_fee)
FROM 
    reason
JOIN web_returns ON wr_reason_sk = r_reason_sk
JOIN web_sales ON ws_order_number = wr_order_number AND ws_item_sk = wr_item_sk
JOIN customer_address ON ca_address_sk = wr_refunded_addr_sk
JOIN date_dim ON d_date_sk = ws_sold_date_sk
JOIN customer_demographics ON cd_demo_sk = wr_refunded_cdemo_sk OR cd_demo_sk = wr_returning_cdemo_sk
WHERE 
    d_year = 1998
    AND (
        (ca_state IN ('NC', 'TX', 'IA') AND ws_sales_price BETWEEN 100.00 AND 150.00)
        OR (ca_state IN ('WI', 'WV', 'GA') AND ws_sales_price BETWEEN 50.00 AND 100.00)
        OR (ca_state IN ('OK', 'VA', 'KY') AND ws_sales_price BETWEEN 150.00 AND 200.00)
    )
GROUP BY 
    SUBSTRING(r_reason_desc FROM 1 FOR 20),
    AVG(ws_quantity),
    AVG(wr_refunded_cash),
    AVG(wr_fee)
ORDER BY 
    SUBSTRING(r_reason_desc FROM 1 FOR 20),
    AVG(ws_quantity),
    AVG(wr_refunded_cash),
    AVG(wr_fee)
LIMIT 100
